description: Issue #961: neutralizes the header-value log-leak fix in RestWidgetDataSource.FetchJsonAsync's header-adding catch block by re-chaining the original FormatException/InvalidOperationException as InnerException (adding back ', ex' to the InvalidOperationException constructor call). For a parser-backed header (Authorization) .NET's own FormatException.Message embeds the FULL raw attempted header value; _DashboardController.GetWidgetData/PostWidgetData catch the resulting InvalidOperationException and pass it whole to ILogger.LogWarning(ex, ...), so re-chaining puts the secret back into whatever a logging sink renders via Exception.ToString() (which walks the InnerException chain). red_tests are the two log-leak regression tests in RestWidgetHeaderValueLogLeakTests961 (embedded newline, and non-ASCII text combined with an embedded NUL -- see that test class's own XML doc for why pure non-ASCII alone does not reach this code path on .NET 10). green_test is the positive control proving the header NAME still reaches the log under this mutant (unaffected by chaining/not-chaining the inner exception, since the name lives in the outer message both ways) -- without it, a hypothetical broader mutant that also silenced the header name would slip through undetected by the red tests alone.
target_symbol: RestWidgetDataSource.FetchJsonAsync(...) -- the header-adding catch block's `throw new InvalidOperationException(...)`, line ~836

red_expected_assertion_patterns.WalkingTec.Mvvm.Core.Test.Dashboard.Rest: to contain "s3cr3t-A1B2C3-do-not-log-me" because the secret must never reach the log
to contain "機密憑證A1B2C3" because the secret must never reach the log

red_expected_assertion_patterns_observed:
Captured from an actual `python3 test/mutants/run_mutant.py --mutant 961-restwidget-header-exception-chain-reintroduce` run (which builds/tests at -c Release, per #959) against this exact patch/entry pair. Both declared red tests failed with FluentAssertions' StringAssertions.NotContain message, e.g. for the newline test: 'Did not expect string "[Dashboard] Widget data fetch failed. DashboardId=d1 WidgetId=w1
System.InvalidOperationException: REST widget: header 'Authorization' was rejected by the HTTP stack (possible invalid characters or CRLF in name/value; underlying error: FormatException).
 ---> System.FormatException: The format of value 'Bearer s3cr3t-A1B2C3-do-not-log-me
X-Injected: evil' is invalid. ...' to contain "s3cr3t-A1B2C3-do-not-log-me" because the secret must never reach the log, whether via the message template or the logged exception's own text.' -- confirming the mutant's re-chained InnerException.Message (the raw FormatException text) is exactly what CapturingLogger's Exception.ToString() rendering picks up. The non-ASCII test failed the same way with the Chinese-text fragment. The narrower regex (anchored on the fixed FluentAssertions suffix text rather than trying to span the multi-line exception dump with `.*`, which does not match newlines under Python's default re flags) was needed after a first attempt with a `.*`-spanning pattern produced VERDICT: UNEXPECTED_RED for a benign reason (pattern mismatch only, not a wrong-cause failure) -- re-run after narrowing produced VERDICT: KILLED. Ran three times back-to-back to confirm determinism (no flake observed).
